_comment: Pre-registration of the Forecast-to-Allocation Sensitivity Experiment. Written and committed before any scenario was run. Scenario definitions are fixed by this file and are not revised after results are seen.
research_question: How much does a change in each approach's forecast or investment view change its final portfolio allocation, returns, risk, turnover and economic performance, and where in each native pipeline is signal information attenuated?
design_note: Signal transmission and signal predictive quality are separate questions. This experiment measures transmission. A strong response to an uninformative forecast is not value, and a weak response to an informative forecast is not absence of value.

protected.note: never opened, never scored, never used to choose a multiplier

window.walk_forward: unchanged native timing: decide at the decision close, trade at the entry close, hold to the exit close

scenarios.transformation: Adjusted view = Prior view + lambda x (Original view - Prior view), applied per decision month at the single point where a numerical view enters the native allocator
scenarios.lambda_2_note: 2x is a counterfactual diagnostic stress test, not a deployment recommendation
what_is_never_changed: the native prior or equilibrium portfolio

AP1.name: Deterministic Quantitative Model (Stage 2 System A)
AP1.native_allocator: Black-Litterman with a bounded fully-invested mean-variance optimum
AP1.original_view: stage2_predictions.csv prediction_excess_return, system A, per asset per decision month (archived run stage2/results/dev_rerun_v4_portfolio_2026-10-27)
AP1.prior_view: pi_t = DELTA * Sigma_t @ PRIOR_WEIGHTS, computed inside bl_posterior from the native 45/35/20 equilibrium; archived per month as pi_* in stage2_portfolio_bl_diagnostics.csv
AP1.transformation: q_t(lambda) = pi_t + lambda * (q_t - pi_t), per asset
AP1.intermediate_stage_exposed: mu_BL(lambda) and the unconstrained bounded optimum; the optimizer's bound-enumeration states identify which bounds bind

fixed_constants.omega: frozen diagonal from System A development OOS errors

AP1.lambda_0_prediction: mu_BL = pi_t exactly, so lambda=0 removes all incremental forecast information while preserving the native prior and the native allocation process. The resulting weights are NOT expected to equal the static 45/35/20 portfolio, because the optimizer uses Sigma_post = Sigma + M while pi was defined with Sigma. This difference is pre-declared as legitimate and will be measured, not corrected.

AP2B.name: Agentic Workflow - JEV
AP2B.native_allocator: capped tilt on the stock-minus-bond edge (NOT Black-Litterman on the Deterministic model's path)
AP2B.original_view: the saved JEV answer's five-way tilt offset in points (TILT_OFFSET strong_equities 3, lean_equities 1.5, neutral 0, lean_bonds -1.5, strong_bonds -3) weighted by the saved confidence
AP2B.prior_view: baseEdge = (pi_0 - pi_1) * 100 from the native 60/40 equilibrium
AP2B.transformation: offset_t(lambda) = lambda * offset_t, which is exactly edge_t(lambda) = baseEdge_t + lambda * confidence_t * offset_t
AP2B.intermediate_stage_exposed: xRaw, the unclipped SPY weight, is recorded by the native engine before the clip

constraints.no_trade_band: not active in this backtest: the engine calls allocate with previousSpy = null

AP2B.lambda_0_prediction: edge = baseEdge gives xRaw exactly 0.60, so JEV's lambda=0 coincides exactly with its native 60/40 no-signal control. This is pre-declared and will be verified numerically.

AP2A.name: Agentic Workflow - Agent Committee (saved gpt-4o views)
AP2A.entry_point: native_backtest/vendor/protofin_approach-2_ce063b8/site/js/allocation.js::allocate -> blPosterior(pi, sigma, q, confidence), where q = (viewsTotalPct - rf) / 100
AP2A.original_view: saved gpt-4o committee views spy_q and tlt_q in total-return percent, with the saved confidence level
AP2A.prior_view: pi = equilibriumPrior(sigma) from the native 60/40 equilibrium
AP2A.transformation: q_t(lambda) = pi_t + lambda * (q_t - pi_t), passed to the native allocator as viewsTotalPct(lambda) = 100 * q_t(lambda) + rf_t so that no native code is modified
AP2A.intermediate_stage_exposed: the allocator returns pi, er, unconstrained and target_spy
AP2A.confidence_treatment: OMEGA_SCALE {High 0.5, Medium 1.0, Low 2.0} is a native uncertainty setting and is NOT scaled

AP3.name: Agentic Causal RAG
AP3.reason: Genuine qwen3:4b outputs cover 12 of the 95 required months (2015-02..2016-01) and both pre-registered reliability gates failed (G3a schema-valid call rate 0.9771 < 0.98; G3b accuracy 0.5667 < 0.80 with 2 opposite-direction errors > 1). No calibrated numerical view series exists for the 46 development months, so no sensitivity scenario can be run.
AP3.planned_entry_point: the calibrated numerical view produced after the Testing Agent's categorical assessments are encoded and calibrated, never the categorical labels themselves
AP3.explicit_prohibition: Supported, Contradicted and Insufficient are categories, not magnitudes, and are never multiplied. Scaling applies only downstream of calibration.
AP3.machinery: the same scenario, tracing and statistics machinery is prepared now and will be applied unchanged when genuine outputs for the development window exist

no_signal_controls.definition: Each approach's own native no-signal control, as frozen in framework_config_v1.json systems.<id>.native_neutral_weights and used by the Signal Value-Added study

AP1.also_compared_to: Stage 2's BENCH_HISTMEAN_ALLOCATOR, the same allocator fed historical-mean views

no_signal_controls.policy: lambda=0 and the native no-signal control are distinct constructs. They are compared, and any difference is documented and explained rather than assumed away.

accounting.evaluator: native_backtest/framework/accounting.simulate_records, unchanged and shared by every approach and scenario
accounting.cost_basis: 0.0005 * sum |w - p| against the drifted pre-trade weights p

metrics.primary: net certainty-equivalent return (net CER), 12 * (mean(excess) - 1.25 * var(excess, ddof=1)), and its difference versus the same approach at lambda = 1
secondary: mean absolute active weight versus the native neutral portfolio
mean and maximum absolute weight deviation from lambda=1
share of months with a binding constraint, per bound
correlation of monthly net returns between scenarios
active return versus the approach's own native no-signal control
transmission: view change versus lambda=1, in basis points of expected excess return (AP1, AP2A) or points of edge (AP2B)
constraint attenuation = 1 - (final weight change / intermediate weight change), reported only where the denominator clears the floor
local finite-difference sensitivity around lambda=1, estimated as the symmetric slope between the 0.5x and 2x scenarios in weight per unit of view
metrics.units: weights in absolute portfolio weight and percentage points; views in basis points of monthly expected excess return or in edge points; CER in annualized percentage points

statistics.method: paired circular block bootstrap on the monthly net excess return series
statistics.pairing: every scenario and control is resampled on the same block draws, so scenario differences are paired
limitations_declared_in_advance: 46 months is a small sample and the intervals are wide
four scenarios per approach are examined, so no single interval is a confirmatory test
no multiplicity correction is applied and none of these comparisons is treated as confirmatory
a bootstrap p-value is not a claim of significance and will not be described as one

policies.missing_data: a decision month without a valid native view is excluded, counted and reported; no view, weight or return is ever imputed
policies.constraint_binding: recorded per month, per asset and per bound, from the native allocator's own output
policies.tiny_denominators: a transmission ratio is reported only where the absolute intermediate weight change is at least 1e-6; months below the floor are counted and flagged, never divided
policies.failure_handling: a scenario that cannot be computed for an approach is reported as not computed, with the reason; no substitution from another approach, no synthetic view, no fabricated result

reproduction_tolerance.note: lambda=1 must reproduce the archived allocation and net return series to this tolerance; a larger difference stops the experiment until it is explained

policies.frozen_artifacts: no frozen configuration, decision record, archived run or previously reported result is modified; all scenario output is written to a new folder

outputs.independent_validation: a framework-free rebuild of the headline numbers that imports neither the scenario script nor the evaluation framework
